name: Can I sue a doctor for misdiagnosis if it didn't cause physical harm?

mainEntity.name: Can I sue a doctor for misdiagnosis if it didn't cause physical harm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, to have a successful medical malpractice claim for misdiagnosis, you must demonstrate that the misdiagnosis or delayed diagnosis caused you actual harm or injury. This harm can include physical injury, worsening of a condition, prolonged suffering, or financial damages due to additional medical treatments or lost income. Emotional distress alone, without physical harm, is often not sufficient for a malpractice claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: A successful misdiagnosis claim typically requires proof that the misdiagnosis caused you actual physical harm or injury.
